_comment: The package.json fields an Electron + Next.js desktop build needs. Merge
these into the real package.json - JSON has no comments, so the notes
live in these _comment keys and should be deleted once copied.
Generate the node_modules entries in build.files with the skill's

scripts.dist: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder
scripts.release: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --publish always

build._comment_asar: Native binaries that get executed (a database server) cannot reliably be chmod'd or run from inside the app.asar virtual archive. Chasing asarUnpack globs file-by-file is repeatedly wrong; turning asar off makes everything real files on disk.
build._comment_subnodemodules: electron-builder treats ANY directory named node_modules - nested included - as a gate evaluated before individual file patterns. Without this, .next/standalone/node_modules is silently deleted and the packaged app dies with 'Cannot find module next'.
build._comment_files: Order matters. The negation must come before the re-includes, and .next/standalone must come after them.
build._comment_win: signtool enumerating the Windows certificate store hangs the build forever when no certificate is configured. This plus CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false on the script is electron-builder's documented escape hatch.
build._comment_publish: Only if using auto-update. Point at a PUBLIC releases repo holding nothing but installers, so the source repo can stay private - a client-side token in an installer is not a secret.
